title: playwright-stealth pinned to 0.0.1 — only published version; evaluate maintained replacement
detail: apps/news-fetch/package.json pins playwright-stealth@0.0.1. This is the only version ever published to npm (no ^1.0.0 exists). The package is effectively abandoned. For 1899a-factory (PlaywrightBrowserFactory), evaluate: (a) playwright-extra + puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth as the actively maintained replacement, (b) custom stealth inject via page.addInitScript. The 0.0.1 pin is fine for the scaffold skeleton but MUST be resolved before any browser launch code ships in 1899a-factory.
recommendation: Replace playwright-stealth@0.0.1 with playwright-extra + puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth in apps/news-fetch/package.json during 1899a-factory task. Update Dockerfile and bun.lock accordingly.
